A lifestyle change

Audio script

Paul: Hey Stephanie, how’s it going?

Stephanie: OK thanks. Guess what? I’m trying a no-sugar diet for a month.

Paul: What?! But you love chocolate and sweets. You always have something for dessert. You can’t live without sugar! So, how’s it going?

Stephanie: OK, so far. I’m trying lots of new types of food and drink. I miss chocolate, though. I usually have some for a snack, but now I just have some fruit instead – an apple, or something.

Paul: And what about exercise?

Stephanie: Well, I’m not doing any sport at the moment, but I walk to work every day. It’s great actually, I feel a lot better!

Paul: Well, seriously, that’s brilliant, Stephanie. Well done!
